gate.reason: `install::project_modeline` reads YAML frontmatter only (it opens on `frontmatter::frontmatter_matter(source)?` and returns `None` where there is no block); a JSON document's native `$schema` key or a TOML equivalent needs its own design before `schema`/`install` extend to those kinds. Ruled (interactive, 2026-07-23) explicitly NOT build's to invent — surface only, never half-invent it. Revive when a JSON/TOML-kind keystroke gap has a real driver.

edit.description: Anticipated: `schema_ref` and `project_modeline` grow a JSON-document and/or TOML-document variant once a design exists — a JSON `$schema` top-level key insertion (JSON has no comment channel, so no `MODELINE_MARKER` prefix); a TOML equivalent is unprecedented and needs its own ruling. Symbols, not line numbers: both names resolve by `rg`, and re-measuring their offsets each audit was a tax on a deferred entry — the +6 shift 0d4a461a's guard-half rework bought is the third such re-measure.

summary: Keystroke JSON Schema wiring for JSON/TOML-document kinds (settings-local, plugin-manifest, marketplace, dial) has no modeline mechanism — deferred out of the YAML-frontmatter widening.

per.section: The placements and their enforcement modes

acceptance: A JSON- or TOML-document kind (settings-local, plugin-manifest, marketplace, dial, or a declared kind sharing one of those formats) gets keystroke schema validation wired by `install`, once a modeline-equivalent mechanism is designed for its format.
